sourceNotes.backendApi: IREE (Intermediate Representation Execution Environment) provides a compiler and runtime for generating code targeting hardware APIs, device architectures, and performance profiles. IREE's HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) is the public API surface used here as a reference. Source: openxla.org/iree. This profile models a hypothetical custom NPU that would be targeted via an IREE-style HAL backend.
sourceNotes.allFields: All capability fields in this entry are declared_profile. This is a demo profile for illustrating how custom accelerators would be registered in the BackendCapability schema. No real 'mychip_npu' silicon exists; no fields are measured or independently verifiable.
sourceNotes.int4_weight_only: INT4 weight-only quantization is a common mode for on-device LLM serving where weights are stored in INT4 and dequantized to FP16 before compute. Included here as a demo of the quant_mode schema capability, not as a claim about any specific hardware.
sourceNotes.flash_attention: Included as a supported fusion pattern to demonstrate that the schema can express operation-level fusion capabilities for custom accelerators.
